text_en: When I kill, it's all over..._500_ just energy flowing directly into me._300_ But you, little men, you are amusing.

You leave behind a shell of what you were and fall to the ground._500_
It brings back memories...
Isn't it incredible..._300_ what we can do in this place...?
You did what those poor guys couldn't.
But, to be honest, I didn't come after you just so I could praise you.
I noticed that you're looking for some gems that seem to fit in the entrance door.
I found it before you showed up._300_ My game is stealing treasure, not protecting it. I think it'd be better off in your hands.
We should find the rest to see if that great door can lead us out of here.
